verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI documents filter-based bulk data operations: users can delete data and add or remove tags from all data matching a given filter, and run SQL/MQL queries across tabular or binary data. Fleet-level OTA updates for software and ML models suggest changes can reach many machines, but bulk operations on machines, components or configs are not explicitly documented as batch actions. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operations on machines and configurations (e.g., applying fragments or commands across many machines at once), documentation of bulk-operation scale and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
